notes: §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR7: "Subtotalling is accomplished only during execution of GENERATE statements and after any control break processing but before processing of the detail report group"; crossfooting and rolling forward happen while a control footing is processed (§1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR10 a, b, before its USE procedure c). GenerateCore runs ProcessControlFootings for a break, then the subtotal loop (Terms.Fires honouring UPON, Accumulate per addition), then PresentBody of the detail; BeginGroup does ApplyRolled(crossFoot) before RunBeforeReporting; TerminateCore adds nothing. The 85 compile reaches the same runtime. Probed at 85: a detail's USE BEFORE REPORTING sees the counter including its own addend (1.5, 3.5); the break footing excludes the breaking detail (3.5 not 7.5); UPON DA skips DB, UPON DB DB adds -0.5 twice (GR10); crossfoot X2=S2+S2B=2.5; roll-forward S1=7.5, S1R RESET ON FINAL 14.5, final SF=15.5; a USE that ADDs 100 to S2 does not reach S1 (rolled before the USE); TERMINATE with a new AMT adds nothing; GENERATE report-name subtotals (19 with a Procedure ADD 10, GR6), a subscripted addend uses I's value at each GENERATE; SUM in a DETAIL COBOL6763. Leads for other rows: SUM TA(I) * 2 and SUM OF TA(I) (2002 forms, §2002 F.2 item 134) are accepted at 85; an 18-digit counter overflow drops the field from the printed line (size error, undefined at 85). Witness: one-control report whose footing USE shows 3 then 4.

next.reason: 1985: "Crossfooting and rolling forward are accomplished during the processing of control footing report groups."; 2023: "adding takes place when the report group description containing data-name-1 is processed.". Both add during GENERATE/TERMINATE. 2023 ties crossfoot/rollforward to processing of any report group, not only control footings, and does not state subtotalling as after control break processing.
